[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested cocktail recipes include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Lavender Delights**:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Lavender Gin Fizz: 1 1/2 oz gin, 1/2 oz fresh lime juice, 1/2 oz lavender syrup, 1/2 oz simple syrup, topped with soda water, garnished with a lavender sprig and lime wheel.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Lavender Syrup: Steep 1/4 cup dried lavender buds in 1 cup granulated sugar and 1 cup water for 10-15 minutes, strain, and store in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Lavender Dream: 2 oz vodka, 1 oz lavender syrup, 1 oz lemon juice, 1/2 oz honey syrup, shaken and strained into a coupe glass, garnished with a lavender sprig.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Grapefruit Glamour**:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Grapefruit Basil Martini: 2 oz gin, 1 oz fresh grapefruit juice, 1/2 oz lime juice, 1/2 oz basil syrup, shaken and strained into a chilled martini glass, garnished with a grapefruit twist and basil leaf.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Basil Syrup: Steep 1/4 cup fresh basil leaves in 1 cup granulated sugar and 1 cup water for 10-15 minutes, strain, and store in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Grapefruit Rosemary Sparkler: 2 oz tequila, 1 oz fresh grapefruit juice, 1/2 oz lime juice, 1/2 oz rosemary syrup, shaken and strained into a highball glass filled with ice, topped with soda water, garnished with a grapefruit slice and rosemary sprig.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Combining Lavender and Grapefruit**:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Lavender Grapefruit Spritz: 2 oz prosecco, 1 oz grapefruit juice, 1/2 oz lavender syrup, splash of soda water, garnished with a grapefruit slice and lavender sprig.
